scope: Self-contained checks for the imported Remastered Dune II build; no DOS execution and no original EXE/ZIP access in default tests

preloadVerification.method: Statically parse one Emscripten loadPackage JSON record without importing its module; verify mjs/data output hashes and original file slice SHA256 values
preloadVerification.pakDuplicatePolicy: First directory occurrence, matching the retained original resource audit; raw archive hash covers later duplicate names

defaultTestSources.campaign: All66 scenarios and three region INIs decoded directly from preloaded SCENARIO.PAK using CP437
defaultTestSources.emc: Original BUILD/UNIT/TEAM resources decoded from preloaded DUNE.PAK
defaultTestSources.voc: Actual223 unique VOC resources, selected by retained audit identity and verified by archive/member hashes
defaultTestSources.wsa: Actual6 continuation resources and1 normal initial resource, selected and hash-verified against retained fixture metadata
defaultTestSources.cutscenes: Retained original table rawHex and163 retained string excerpts; numeric/pointer/string correspondence and C patch idempotence. This is not fresh EXE verification.

requirements: Clang++ with C++17 support for original-register golden regression
